pages.text: Hold R (default) to open the sign wheel and choose Sign Mastery next to HUD Settings. Eligible sign hits and contracts award points. Repeated hits on the same target are limited.
Each upgrade has three levels costing 2, 4 and 6 points. Alternate forms require 2, 4 or 6 total upgrade levels in that sign and cost 3, 4 or 5 points. Assign unlocked forms to two slots.
